statusDetail: Cloudflare returned an “Attention Required” block page for the entry URL, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml from the audit environment (Ray IDs varied by request), so the actual bet365 site, routes, controls, and user journeys were unreachable.

page.notes: Only a Cloudflare security block document was observable. It is not treated as the target site.

artifacts.caption: Desktop recon shows the Cloudflare “Sorry, you have been blocked” response instead of bet365.
Rendered DOM is Cloudflare’s block document, with title “Attention Required! | Cloudflare” and no bet365 application content.
Recon probe confirms the block text, Cloudflare-only link set, and absence of a manifest.
Attempt to inspect robots.txt returned the same Cloudflare block page.
Attempt to inspect sitemap.xml returned the same Cloudflare block page.
Exact 58-pair atomic coverage manifest generated from the pinned principles catalog.
Per-check evidence plan and coverage intent; execution was blocked before site inspection.
Atomic coverage validator output showing 58 blocked checks and an incomplete publication gate.
